name: Tavily
short: AI-native search and contextual web content retrieval API optimized for autonomous agents, tool calling, and RAG architectures.

plans.name: Researcher Plan (Free)
plans.notes: Instant API key upon dashboard signup (no credit card required) with 1,000 free search credits refreshed on the 1st of every month for local agent workflows.

plans.name: Project Plan
plans.notes: 4,000 credits per month with pay-as-you-go overages ($0.008/credit), higher concurrency, and access to deep multi-step research endpoints.
